name: Veal rolled in rice paper
summary: Thin veal rolled in rice paper with forest greens, boiled until soft and fragrant, or soft and sweet with crisp skin. One account grills the meat just done and rolls it the same way.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động, Tuổi Trẻ on 25 Jun 2018, and Báo Quốc tế each describe bò tơ cuốn bánh tráng. Tuổi Trẻ calls the boiled roll the plate people order most.
howToEat: Người Lao Động boils or steams thin rounds, skin on, with spring-onion tops and ginger, and rolls bánh tráng phơi sương with forest greens, a little bún, and sour pickles. The dip is sweet-sour fish sauce, or mắm nêm with chopped pineapple.

Tuổi Trẻ rolls boiled veal with lá cóc, lá ổi, celery, spring onion, and mango tips, and also describes belly or shank rolled with raw greens. Báo Quốc tế grills the veal just done, then rolls it with forest greens.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Veal rolled in rice paper in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Thin Cu Chi veal rolled in rice paper with forest greens, boiled or grilled just done.
taste: Boiled, the meat is soft and fragrant, or soft and sweet with crisp skin. Grilled just done, it is soft and fragrant.
